pending_commit.commit_message: test: Add new 'session' for test session and invocation. What we used to put in 'factory' module for 'general test utilities' are actually utilities for test sessions (which, in current implementation, is provided by the test harness Goofy). This change merged `testlog_goofy`, `utils/test_invocation`, `utils/update_utils#GetToolkitVersion` into the new `session` module. utils: Add 'CachedGetter' for getter functions that rarely changes. There are many getter functions, especially those value won't change until reboot, wants their value to be cached. This @CachedGetter provides an easy way to help caching getter function results without adding global variables. Umpire: Add environment migration mechanism. To avoid asking Umpire users to manually upgrade or reinstall Umpire, we'd like to add an environment migration mechanism. This change: 1. Add a file 'env.json' to store Umpire environment information. 2. Move initial environment setup instructions from umpired to migrations, and make umpired automatically run migrations when starting. 3. Remove unused directory 'bin'.
